name: Kanto Dive
description: Full-Kanto 2D HM08 DIVE overhaul: every real water area gets a generated underwater layer, continuous hydrology beneath bridges/docks/pontoons, seamless route connections, enlarged open-ocean spaces, biome-aware 2D scenery, submerged cave/harbor links and sparse salvage. HM08 is given unconditionally by a fixed researcher outside, just left of the Cinnabar Lab. With Wilds of Kanto, visible Pokedex-scaled underwater Pokemon trigger battles only on direct sprite contact. Includes HM06 WHIRLPOOL, HM07 WATERFALL, Crystal 251 and Dramatic Sky Ride compatibility.
